--- title: Makira description: The standard SHAUGHV sans — one face for titles, interfaces, body copy, and controls. sidebar: icon: type order: 2 --- Makira is the versatile sans in the standard pair. It is not reserved for headlines. Use it anywhere the surface should feel owned without a fixed-pitch grid.
Display / 700

One address. Every asset.

Body / 400

Fonts, marks, favicons, figurines, and browser-ready motion for SHAUGHV projects. Link the exact thing you need. Use it anywhere.

UI label / 700

Asset delivery / CDN

## Load it The standard bundle already includes Makira. A project that only wants this family can still link the dedicated file: ```html ``` ## CSS families | Name | Use | | --- | --- | | `"Makira"` | Static cuts, 400–900 | | `"Makira VF"` | Variable 400–900 | ```css .hero-title { font-family: "Makira", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } ``` ## Files on the CDN - fonts/makira/ - makira.css - woff2/ — browser-first webfonts - woff/ - ttf/ - otf/ - variable/ — `"Makira VF"` Static filenames follow `Makira-Regular.woff2`, `Makira-Medium.woff2`, `Makira-SemiBold.woff2`, `Makira-Bold.woff2`, `Makira-ExtraBold.woff2`, and `Makira-Black.woff2`. :::tip If a cut ever needs a hint regen or a glyph addition, ship a new filename. Binary objects are cached as immutable. Never overwrite `Makira-Bold.woff2` in place. ::: ## License Makira is commercially licensed for authorized SHAUGHV use. Public font URLs do not grant permission to redistribute its binaries. Use the hosted CSS rather than committing it to public repositories.
